metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and radio communication module
metadata.technology_reasoning: Capacitive soil moisture sensors are widely used in agriculture and IoT for accurate soil moisture measurement with low power consumption. The integration of an MCU and radio module (commonly sub-GHz or 2.4 GHz wireless) is the typical industry standard for remote sensing and data transmission in modern smart agriculture applications, representing the dominant design as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Core functional element measuring soil moisture via capacitance; universally present as primary sensing component
Central processing unit controlling sensor operation and data processing; standard separate IC component in these devices
Wireless transceiver module (e.g., LoRa, Zigbee, or Sub-GHz) for data transmission; critical for remote telemetry and commonly a distinct module
Provides power to sensor electronics; typically a separate battery pack or power module in remote sensing probes
Physical platform integrating electronics like MCU, radio, and sensor interface; standard separate manufacture unit
Structural and environmental protection for electronics and sensor probe; typically a distinct molded or machined part

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Ceramic
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Commonly used dielectric material in capacitive sensing probes due to its stable permittivity and durability; moderately confident as alternatives exist but ceramic is standard.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Silicon dioxide
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Used as insulating layer on silicon substrates and for surface passivation, typical in capacitive sensors; commonly applied for electrical insulation.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Copper
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Essential material for the electrode traces in the capacitive sensing probe due to its high electrical conductivity; universally used in sensor electrodes.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Epoxy resins
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Used as encapsulant or protective coating to seal the probe from soil and moisture; commonly used polymer with alternatives like silicone but epoxy is standard.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Glass
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Sometimes used as substrate or protective cover due to its insulating and mechanical properties; alternatives exist like plastic but glass is common.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Silicon
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Core semiconductor material for the MCU chip essential for integrated circuit function; absolutely essential with no commercial alternative.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Copper
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used extensively for interconnections, package leads, and internal wiring due to excellent conductivity; universally standard.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Gold
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used for wire bonding inside the chip package due to corrosion resistance and good conductivity; alternatives like copper wires exist but gold is common.

Radio Communication Module.name: Silicon
Radio Communication Module.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material for RF integrated circuits and digital control circuits; industry standard with no substitute at scale.

Radio Communication Module.name: Copper
Radio Communication Module.reasoning: Essential for antenna traces, interconnections, and ground planes due to conductivity; universally used.

Radio Communication Module.name: Ceramic
Radio Communication Module.reasoning: Used in resonators, filters, and dielectric substrates for RF components; commonly used with alternatives like plastic but ceramic preferred for performance.

Power Supply/Battery Module.name: Lithium
Power Supply/Battery Module.reasoning: Primary energy storage element in lithium-ion batteries, absolutely essential for modern battery modules in sensors.

Power Supply/Battery Module.name: Copper
Power Supply/Battery Module.reasoning: Used in current collectors and internal wiring due to high electrical conductivity; universally used in battery design.

Power Supply/Battery Module.name: Aluminum
Power Supply/Battery Module.reasoning: Commonly used for cathode current collectors and packaging material; industry standard though some designs use steel.

Power Supply/Battery Module.name: Graphite
Power Supply/Battery Module.reasoning: Anode material critical for lithium intercalation and battery functionality; universal in lithium-ion batteries.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Copper
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Primary conductor material for PCB traces and interconnections; universal standard in PCBs.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Epoxy resins
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used as matrix resin for PCB substrates (e.g., FR4), providing mechanical support and insulation; industry standard with few alternatives.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Glass
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used as reinforcing fiber in glass epoxy laminates for mechanical strength; standard in PCB production.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB).name: Silver
Printed Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Sometimes used in solder and surface plating to enhance conductivity and corrosion resistance; alternatives exist but silver is common for high-quality PCBs.

Enclosure and Protective Housing.name: Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene
Enclosure and Protective Housing.reasoning: Widely used thermoplastic for durable, impact-resistant enclosures; standard material for sensor housing.

Enclosure and Protective Housing.name: Polycarbonate
Enclosure and Protective Housing.reasoning: High impact strength and optical clarity make it common for sensor windows or housing parts; standard polymer with some alternatives.

Enclosure and Protective Housing.name: Silicon dioxide
Enclosure and Protective Housing.reasoning: Possible coating or glass components for protective surfaces; less common and more optional.

Enclosure and Protective Housing.name: Aluminum
Enclosure and Protective Housing.reasoning: Used in metal housings for thermal management and structural strength; sometimes used instead of plastic enclosures.
